deepdive.sec: IT Services — AI-Led Digital Transformation & Enterprise Modernization

bull_bear.body: - Disciplined deal selection (all deals long-term margin-accretive); continued investment in talent/IP/software licenses, calibrated to growth. FCF +94% YoY (US$167mn), ROCE 28.3% — strong capital efficiency. Portfolio-company consolidation/liquidation of underperformers continues (SG&A benefit). No specific dividend/buyback commentary this call.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- **European-auto pull-forward reversal** (~1–1.3% Q2 revenue drag) — must be offset by large-deal ramps + base performance.
- **Wage bill (Q2)** + **AI productivity pressure** on pricing — margin discipline "not taken for granted."
- **Comms volatility** — a large US telecom client volatile; cloud pass-through pullback (reverses Q2).
- **Competition "irrational"** on productivity/price guarantees — a demand-quality risk if TechM must match to win.
- **Memory/chip inflation ~20% YoY** — refuses to guarantee for 3–5-yr deals.
- **Client contract-signing delays** — one or two multi-year examples (in-house vs outsource, AI-benefit questions); mgmt says "not different from 25+ years" and no outsized cancellations. No ramp-up delays worth worrying about.
- **Demand-challenged areas:** manual testing, traditional big data, standalone e-commerce, legacy CRM, legacy infra admin.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident but disciplined — "final year of transformation," proud of the journey, yet repeatedly refuses to give specific growth numbers ("foolhardy" / "hard to forecast beyond a quarter or two"), which reads as credible given large-deal binary-outcome candor. Mohit Joshi (25+ yrs industry) is precise on demand nuances (winners vs challenged areas) and openly names competitor "irrationality" with concrete examples. CFO Rohit Anand quantifies headwinds cleanly (European-auto 1–1.3% Q2). Overall: high-quality, numbers-grounded, low-hype.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- **Growth quality > the print:** the strong quarter was partly an auto pull-forward (~1–1.3%), so the "clean" run-rate is a touch lower — but every vertical grew YoY and the large-deal ramp (not yet started) is the real Q2+ driver.
- **The margin story is shifting composition:** Q1 expansion was SG&A-led (portfolio consolidation); gross-margin levers (Fortius/FP-productivity/T&M-utilisation) are still largely UNSPENT — supportive of the 15% exit even against wage + AI-pricing headwinds.
- **Headcount down 7% YoY is NOT a demand signal** — it's AI-driven FP productivity + repurposing; hiring resumes in H2. Onsite-offshore pyramid lever is deferred (rebadge + onsite-heavy SAP/ServiceNow) — a margin lever for LATER years, not FY27.
- **"SaaS eclipse" explicitly rejected** — enterprise-app (SAP/ServiceNow/Salesforce) demand strengthening; a useful counter-read to bearish IT-services SaaS-disruption narratives.
- **AI is both opportunity and operating-model risk** — some traditional work compresses/needs new commercial constructs (token economics, AI FinOps, outcome-linked delivery) even as new demand expands.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body:
- **Comms/telecom depth:** full-stack across OSS/BSS + networks + own software packages; ability to build a telecom SLM from scratch AND fit an agentic action-harness onto it — cited as a genuine, hard-to-replicate differentiator.

- **Recognitions:** 2026 Google Cloud Partner of the Year (manufacturing); Time's most sustainable (No.1 Indian corporate); Frost & Sullivan (Orion Marketplace).

business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Litigation - erstwhile Satyam] Claims made by 37 companies in the City Civil Court for alleged advances amounting to Rs. 12,304 Million are presented separately under "Suspense Account (net)"; management, on the basis of current legal status, lack of documentation and external legal opinion, believes these claims will not be payable on final adjudication, and the auditor's opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.
- [Litigation - status] Of the 37 petitions before the City Civil Court, Secunderabad, "one petition has been converted into suit and balance 36 petitions are at various stages of pauperism/suit admission"; legal notices claimed the advances "together with damages/compensation @ 18% per annum till the date of repayment", and the Directorate of Enforcement under PMLA "had directed the erstwhile Satyam not to return the alleged advances until further instructions."
- [Regulation - New Labour Codes] "Effective November 21, 2025, the Government of India notified the four Labour Codes... consolidating 29 existing labour laws"; the Group, "considering the materiality and regulatory driven, non-recurring nature, presented the incremental impact of Rs. 2,724 Million related to Employee Benefit Obligations under 'Exceptional item'."
- [Audit opinion] B S R & Co. LLP issued Unmodified Audit Reports on both the Audited Consolidated and Standalone Financial Results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, with an Emphasis of Matter on the erstwhile Satyam matters.
- [Governance] Board meeting held Thursday, 16th July 2026 commenced at 2.15 p.m. (IST) and concluded at 3.55 p.m. (IST), and was thereafter adjourned to be convened on Friday, 17th July 2026; results signed by Mohit Joshi, Managing Director & CEO.

latest_quarter.body:
- 14.4% EBIT (+330bps YoY): driven by volume growth + Project Fortius savings; partially offset by Comviva seasonality + business mix. This quarter's expansion was SG&A-led (portfolio-company consolidation).
- Gross-margin levers still in hand: FP productivity, higher T&M utilisation, continued Fortius actions — "mix of both" (GM + SG&A) into coming quarters, all pointed at the 15% target.
- Q1 gross margin carried seasonal negatives: visa/travel costs (Q4→Q1), Comviva seasonality, dilutive European-auto accelerated deliveries.
- Headwinds ahead: Q2 wage bill + AI-driven productivity pass-through pressure on pricing.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- **Q1 FY27 (this):** Revenue US$1.66bn (+6.6% YoY CC), all verticals up YoY, Manufacturing +17.2% (aerospace + accelerated EU-auto); EBIT 14.4% (+330bps YoY, 11th straight quarter of expansion); TCV US$1.078bn (+33% YoY, 3rd >$1bn); PAT US$154mn (+16.2%); FCF +94%, ROCE 28.3%. Avant Techno (Canada) acquired. Guidance reaffirmed: FY27 above-peer growth + 15% op margin (exit Q4 >15%). Wage hike Q2; EU-auto ~1–1.3% pull-forward reverses Q2; IT headcount -7% YoY (AI FP productivity), hiring resumes H2.
- **Q2 FY27 → check:** (1) Whether large-deal ramps offset the EU-auto reversal + wage bill; (2) margin trajectory toward 15% exit (GM levers vs SG&A); (3) Comms recovery (Comviva seasonality + cloud pass-through gone); (4) sustained TCV >$1bn; (5) DSO/FCF normalisation; (6) Manufacturing YoY ex-pull-forward; (7) AI-pricing/productivity pass-through impact.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log (fill each quarter)

outlook.body:
- **FY27 growth:** above peer-average (already ahead in Q1; "meet or exceed"); Rohit framed it as delivering high-single-digit YoY growth. No specific number given ("foolhardy" amid volatility).
- **FY27 operating margin:** 15% target; exit Q4FY27 "upwards of 15%." Beyond FY27 margin path to be spelled out later.
- **European-auto pull-forward:** ~1–1.3% negative revenue impact in Q2 (won't repeat); offset by large-deal ramp-ups + base business.
- **Comms & Manufacturing:** both to GROW YoY through the remainder of the year (Comviva seasonality + cloud pass-through headwinds reverse in Q2).
- **Wage hikes:** effective Q2FY27, phased.
- **IT-services headcount:** down 7% YoY (AI-driven FP productivity, not revenue decline); expects to HIRE in the remainder of FY27 (fresh + experienced).
- **Onsite-offshore pyramid:** offshore-shift margin lever LIMITED this year (large-deal rebadge + onsite-heavy SAP/ServiceNow/Salesforce work); reduction expected in later years, "not in this year."
outlook.title: Guidance (CRITICAL — verify next quarter)

outlook.body:
- TCV US$1.078bn (+33% YoY), broad-based; largest wins Manufacturing + HLS. Third consecutive $1bn+ quarter. ISG named TechM among top-15 sourcing standouts (all regions).
- Notable wins: US regional healthcare system (integrated apps + infra managed services); American autonomous-driving co (HD map dev/maintenance via GIS); global aerospace & defense (database admin + AI ops); global payments-technology co (product engineering); marquee AI-led BPS deal with a large high-tech player (one of the largest AI-led BPS deals).
- Large-deal forecast visibility limited to ~1–2 quarters (binary win/loss); pipeline "quite strong."
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- **Project Helix (AI-led transformation):** platforms + talent + partnerships in one operating model; agentic development & modernization services portfolio launched; TechM Orion (multi-agent orchestration) — 20+ agents on Google Gemini marketplace, 100+ active users; 350+ deployable AI agents; TechM Scale for vendor-consolidation.
- **AI-first across IT + BPS:** outcome-linked deals (healthcare: ~40% fewer tickets, 20% lower MTTR, 30–35% tech-debt cut; telecom: ~2x release velocity, ~40% incident-effort cut). AI ops = "overwhelming majority" of BPS deal TCV this quarter.
- **Partnerships:** Microsoft (5G network digital-twin), Kitsa (agentic medical writing), Telefonica Germany (multi-year AI-first private cloud), Perplexity Enterprise Pro (internal deployment).
- **Domain + sovereign AI:** purpose-built industry models (telecom SLMs w/ agentic harness) — mgmt's stated future differentiator (marry AI onto deep vertical/process knowledge).
- **Demand strengthening:** ServiceNow, SAP, Salesforce; data & AI (Databricks, Snowflake, GenAI); vertical packages (Guidewire, Temenos, LabWare LIMS). "SaaS eclipse" fear NOT materialising — enterprise-app demand strengthening.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: the strongest growth since the transformation began, 350+ agents, Orion platform) is the growth engine, but large-deal ramps are guided to offset.

Management flags statutory compliance risk from tracking changing regulatory requirements across geographies and entities; tracked through the Global Compliance Management System (GCMS).
TechM has set a goal to evaluate the top 250 of its high-spend key suppliers by 2030 for regulatory compliance and ethical/sustainability business conduct.
Project Fortius continues to drive operational rigor through disciplined cost management, improved utilisation, optimised delivery structures and enhanced billing realisation.

TechM has organised its delivery, training, investment and client-evaluation model around the 'AI Delivered Right' strategy, built on four pillars: Transformation, Productivity, Innovation and Assurance Delivered.

Management flags risk of revenue growth stagnation from reduced demand, competitive loss, or global economic slowdown/recession including geopolitical conflicts, though direct revenue exposure to affected regions is a low single-digit percentage of overall revenue and not expected to be material.

Management flags human capital risk from attrition, involuntary churn and work-from-home productivity/security impact; mitigated via smooth leadership transition and introduction of compulsory partial work-from-office.

Management flags impairment and M&A integration risk from declining performance of acquired portfolio companies; mitigated by a dedicated monitoring team, centrally managed integration plan, and Investment Committee oversight.

Management flags cyber security and privacy risk (data theft, cyber attacks); mitigated via data protection controls, cyber security tools, user awareness, supplier risk management, and continuous monitoring/audits.

TechM is progressing Project Indus and participating in the Indian AI Mission; selected by the Government of India as the only large IT services company in a cohort of twelve players tasked with developing sovereign foundational AI models.
TechM has embarked on Project Helix, an AI-native transformation program in which 'Vector Squads' interweave human expertise with AI agents to build enterprise AI systems.
